name: China Tianying Inc.
summary: China Tianying Inc. engages in urban environmental service and energy businesses in China, Europe, and internationally. The company offers design research services, such as industry research, planning construction, engineering design, emerging technologies, and monitoring and analysis services; and waste classification and collection, urban cleaning, and recyclables collection.
